title: Context of the organization
requirement: Determine internal and external issues relevant to purpose and strategic direction, including whether climate change is relevant; monitor and review them

title: Interested parties
requirement: Determine relevant interested parties and their requirements (which can include climate change requirements); monitor and review them
evidence: customer list only; no regulators or suppliers

title: Scope of the QMS
requirement: Define scope with products/services and sites; justify any requirement determined not applicable

title: QMS and its processes
requirement: Determine processes, inputs/outputs, sequence and interaction, criteria, resources, responsibilities, risks; keep documented information to support and evidence operation
evidence: process map QM-01 fig 1; turtle diagrams

title: Leadership and commitment
requirement: Top management takes accountability for QMS effectiveness, ensures policy/objectives fit strategy, integrates QMS into business processes, promotes process approach and risk-based thinking

title: Customer focus
requirement: Top management ensures customer and legal requirements are met, risks to conformity are addressed, focus on customer satisfaction is maintained

title: Quality policy
requirement: Policy is appropriate to purpose and context, gives a framework for objectives, commits to meeting requirements and to continual improvement
evidence: QP-01 rev B signed by MD

title: Communicating the policy
requirement: Policy is available as documented information, communicated, understood and applied, available to interested parties as appropriate

title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
requirement: Assign and communicate responsibility for QMS conformity, process outputs, reporting on performance, customer focus and integrity during change

title: Risks and opportunities
requirement: Determine risks and opportunities from 4.1/4.2, plan proportionate actions, integrate them into processes and evaluate effectiveness

title: Quality objectives
requirement: Set measurable objectives at relevant functions and levels consistent with the policy; plan what, resources, who, when and how results are evaluated
evidence: OTD and scrap targets set; no plan for who/when

title: Planning of changes
requirement: Plan QMS changes considering purpose, consequences, integrity, resources and responsibilities

title: Resources - general
requirement: Determine and provide resources, considering existing internal capability and what is needed from external providers

title: People
requirement: Provide the persons needed to operate and control processes

title: Infrastructure
requirement: Determine, provide and maintain buildings, equipment, software, transport and ICT

title: Process environment
requirement: Determine, provide and maintain the social, psychological and physical environment needed

title: Monitoring and measuring resources
requirement: Ensure measuring resources are suitable and maintained; calibrate or verify at intervals against traceable standards, identify status, act when found out of tolerance

title: Organizational knowledge
requirement: Determine, maintain and make available the knowledge needed; consider how to acquire knowledge for changing needs

title: Competence
requirement: Determine competence, ensure people are competent by education, training or experience, act to close gaps and evaluate the actions
evidence: training matrix exists, no effectiveness check

title: Awareness
requirement: People are aware of the policy, relevant objectives, their contribution and the implications of not conforming

title: Communication
requirement: Determine what, when, with whom, how and who communicates internally and externally

title: Documented information
requirement: Create, identify, format, review and approve documented information; control distribution, access, storage, changes, retention, disposition and external documents

title: Operational planning and control
requirement: Plan, implement and control processes: requirements, criteria, resources, documented information; control planned changes and outsourced processes

title: Customer communication
requirement: Communicate product information, enquiries, contracts, orders, feedback and complaints, customer property, contingencies

title: Determining requirements
requirement: Define product/service requirements including legal ones; ensure the organization can meet its claims

title: Review of requirements
requirement: Review requirements before committing to supply, resolve differences, confirm unstated requirements

title: Changes to requirements
requirement: Amend documented information and inform people when requirements change

title: Design and development
requirement: Plan design stages, inputs, controls (reviews, verification, validation), outputs and changes
evidence: build to customer print; no design responsibility

title: Externally provided processes, products and services
requirement: Set criteria to evaluate, select, monitor and re-evaluate external providers; define controls and communicate requirements

title: Control of production and service provision
requirement: Controlled conditions: documented characteristics and results, measuring resources, monitoring at stages, infrastructure, competent people, validation of special processes, error prevention, release and delivery

title: Identification and traceability
requirement: Identify outputs and their status; control unique identification when traceability is required

title: Customer or external provider property
requirement: Identify, verify, protect and safeguard property; report loss or damage to the owner

title: Preservation
requirement: Preserve outputs during production and delivery (identification, handling, contamination control, packaging, storage, transport, protection)

title: Post-delivery activities
requirement: Meet post-delivery requirements considering legal requirements, consequences, product life, customer requirements and feedback

title: Control of changes
requirement: Review and control production changes; record the review, who authorized and the actions

title: Release of products and services
requirement: Verify requirements are met before release; record evidence of conformity and traceability to the authorizing person

title: Control of nonconforming outputs
requirement: Identify and control nonconforming outputs (correction, segregation, return, inform customer, concession); record the nonconformity, actions, concessions and authority

title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
requirement: Determine what, methods, when to monitor and when to analyse; evaluate performance and effectiveness

title: Customer satisfaction
requirement: Monitor customers' perception of how needs and expectations are met; decide methods to obtain and review it

title: Analysis and evaluation
requirement: Analyse data to evaluate conformity, satisfaction, QMS performance, planning, risk actions, providers and improvement needs

title: Internal audit
requirement: Plan and run an audit programme at planned intervals, defined criteria and scope, objective auditors, report results, take corrections and corrective actions without undue delay

title: Management review
requirement: Top management reviews the QMS at planned intervals with the required inputs and decides on improvement, changes and resources
evidence: one review held; outputs not recorded

title: Improvement - general
requirement: Select opportunities for improvement to meet requirements and enhance satisfaction

title: Nonconformity and corrective action
requirement: React, evaluate need for action to eliminate causes, implement, review effectiveness, update risks and the QMS
